_readme: Where the enquiry form sends. Change `provider` and `endpoint` together.
formsubmit  https://formsubmit.co/ajax/YOUR@EMAIL - free, no account.
The FIRST submission triggers a confirmation email you must
click before anything else arrives. Works on GitHub Pages.
Once activated, swap in their hashed endpoint so your email
address is not sitting in the page source for scrapers.
netlify     Only works when deployed to Netlify, and Forms must be
enabled for the site. Set endpoint to null.
formspree   https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_ID - free tier, needs an account.
web3forms   https://api.web3forms.com/submit - needs a free access key,
which goes in accessKey below.
In `npm run dev` the form posts to the local receiver instead, so you can
test the whole flow without sending anything. Start it with `npm run form:test`.
Set testLocally to false to point dev at the real service.
Where this gets published. Both values end up in canonical URLs, the
sitemap and robots.txt, so they must match reality before you deploy.
GitHub Pages, user site  https://USERNAME.github.io   base: /
GitHub Pages, project    https://USERNAME.github.io   base: /REPO-NAME/
Netlify                  https://SITE.netlify.app     base: /
Own domain               https://kiteaerial.co.uk     base: /
A project repo MUST have the trailing slash on base or every asset 404s.
